raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Every SGLang explainer video now ends with a fixed **关注 SGLang** strip: GitHub `github.com/sgl-project/sglang` · 博客 `sglang.io/blog` · 文档 `docs.sglang.io`.

![follow strip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BBuf/AI-Infra-Auto-Driven-SKILLS/sglang-explainer-video-follow-strip/skills/sglang-explainer-video/assets/brand/follow-strip-example.png)

## Changes
- `assets/brand/follow-strip.html` holds the strip's CSS and markup. The last-frame worker pastes it verbatim.
  - Placement: y 792–872, just above the caption band.
  - It is on screen only and is not narrated.
- `references/house-style.md` adds a new section, §Follow strip. `SKILL.md` step 3 and `references/worker-dispatch.md` were also updated, so the storyboard and the last-frame worker both reserve space for the strip (frame content ends above y≈770).
- `scripts/check_frames.mjs` now fails the last frame if the strip is missing or any of its three URLs is missing.
- Plugin version 0.9.3 → 0.9.4.

## Test
On a copy of the Step 5 Preview project, the strip was pasted into the last frame. Results:
- `check_frames` → OK.
- `subset_fonts` covered the new CJK text.
- `hf lint` → 0 errors.
- `hf snapshot` at the final second shows the strip (the image above).

On the unmodified project, `check_frames` reports `FAIL 17-summary.html — last frame lacks the SGLang follow strip`, as expected.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

 - Only the PR author (name + @login + avatar) and the PR link. No reviewers, approvers, commit counts or status.
 - The name is on screen only — the narration does not read it.
 
+## Follow strip (last frame of every video)
+
+Every SGLang video ends with links that invite viewers to follow the project, as asked by the user.
+
+- The last frame shows the fixed strip from `assets/brand/follow-strip.html` (reference render:
+  `assets/brand/follow-strip-example.png`):
+  - 关注 SGLang
+  - GitHub `github.com/sgl-project/sglang`
+  - 博客 `sglang.io/blog`
+  - 文档 `docs.sglang.io`
+- Where it goes: on the author page in PR videos; on the summary / links frame in article videos.
+- Placement: a peach bar at y 792–872, just above the caption band. The frame's own content ends above y≈770.
+- Timing: the strip rises in by the start of the frame's last clause and stays until the end. The 2 s hold
+  after the last line keeps it readable.
+- Copy it verbatim:
+  - Do not restyle, translate or shorten the URLs.
+  - Do not narrate it.
+  - Do not add other channels (X, Discord, …) unless the user asks.
+- `check_frames.mjs` fails when the last frame lacks the strip or any of its three URLs.
+
 ## Delivery
 
 - Final MP4 and the still cover go straight to `~/Desktop`
